Our Services

Medicines and day-to-day treatment for the whole family — at the store and at the clinic next to it.

Pharmacy — All Medicines

A full-range medical store with all types of medicines and everyday health essentials, in stock at the counter.

Home DeliveryFree

Order on call or WhatsApp and get your medicines delivered free to your home, anywhere within the area.

Doctor Consultation / OPD

Visit the in-house Health Clinic for OPD consultation with Dr. Abhijeet Chaudhari, Family Physician.

Nebulization

Nebulization facility available at the clinic for patients who need inhalation therapy as advised by the doctor.

Dressing

Clean, careful wound dressing and bandaging done at the clinic for cuts, injuries and post-procedure care.

Blood Tests & Diabetes Care

Pathology sample collection for blood tests, along with diabetes testing and ongoing sugar care and follow-up.

How to Order Medicines

Three simple steps — no app, no registration.

1

Send your prescription on WhatsApp

2

We confirm your order

The store confirms your medicines and delivery details with you on the same chat or call.

3

Free delivery at your door

Your medicines reach your doorstep — free home delivery within the area, any day of the week.
